purpose: Open-license visual novel asset sources for the GameTerm Ren'Py demo path.

policy.default: Do not commit downloaded asset archives unless the source entry allows redistribution and attribution/provenance is preserved.
local_only_when: redistribution of raw or modified images is restricted
